title: What happened when you pressed the button
description: You pressed the real button in Preview. The page asked the practice app in the project environment for a greeting; the app prepared it and the page displayed its reply. This picture explains that observed action; it is not the running application or an assessment result.

commands.name: showOverview
commands.description: Connect the page in Preview with the running practice app.

commands.name: highlightClient
commands.description: Point to the page where the learner pressed the real button and read the reply.

commands.name: highlightServer
commands.description: Point to the practice app that prepares the greeting.

commands.name: highlightPort
commands.description: Optional running-app highlight; only verified runtime information may supply a concrete service label.

commands.name: sendRequest
commands.description: Illustrate the page asking for a greeting; method and path are display details, not quiz vocabulary.

commands.name: showServerWork
commands.description: Explain that the app prepares its greeting before replying.

commands.name: sendResponse
commands.description: Illustrate the greeting returning to the page the learner tried.

commands.name: pause
commands.description: Stop motion at the last declared state; repeat a transition to continue.

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Clear labels and return to the overview.
